label: Indonesia
short_description: Road races across Indonesia, including landmark-course marathons like Borobudur.
intro: Indonesia's race calendar includes some of Southeast Asia's most distinctive courses, including marathons routed through UNESCO World Heritage sites, alongside city-based events across Java and beyond.

faqs.question: What's the best time of year to run a race in Indonesia?
faqs.answer: Indonesia's dry season, roughly May through September, is generally preferred for road races since it reduces the chance of heavy rain disrupting a course. Humidity remains high year-round regardless of season, so hydration planning matters for any race in Indonesia no matter which month it falls in.
